instruction: Set Chrome's default font size to Large.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated to Chrome settings > Search engine section and changed default search engine from Google to Microsoft Bing in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Chrome settings, navigate to specific settings sections, use dialogs/dropdowns to change setting values
metadata.task_rationale: Tests same settings-navigation capability in the Appearance section (font size) instead of Search engine section
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing Chrome font size to Large (20px). Uses official chrome_font_size getter and check_font_size metric. Postconfig restarts Chrome to ensure settings are persisted before reading preferences.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'chrome_font_size' correctly reads Chrome Preferences JSON and extracts 'webkit.webprefs' dict containing 'default_font_size' — the right state for this task.
Metric 'check_font_size' correctly extracts 'default_font_size' from the getter result and compares it against rule['value'] (20) using exact equality — appropriate for a discrete font size setting.
Expected value of 20 correctly corresponds to Chrome's 'Large' font size preset (default is 16/Medium, Large is 20).
Postconfig properly kills and restarts Chrome to ensure preferences are flushed to disk before the getter reads the Preferences file.
Single-requirement instruction ('set font size to Large') is fully covered by the single evaluator check — no missing verification steps.

Data flow is correct: expected.type='rule' means metric receives {'type': 'value', 'value': 20} as the 'rule' parameter, and check_font_size accesses rule['type'] and rule['value'] directly — no parameter handling errors.
